items.statement: Named nurses can screen at least 70 percent of eligible admissions, at least 40 percent of screen-positive patients accept the intervention, and at least 60 percent of participants are reached at three months.
items.rationale: Thresholds framed as progression criteria; drawn from the retrieved delivery and follow-up figures (c1, c2) with margins for a busier ward.
items.risks: Follow-up may fall short even with retention strategies.

items.statement: Screening once the patient is well enough gives higher uptake than screening in the first 24 hours.
items.rationale: Suggested by patients' accounts of timing (c3); a comparison would need more patients than the ward will see.
items.risks: Underpowered; better explored in the acceptability conversations.

summary: h1 selected as the feasibility proposition expressed as progression thresholds.
